title: One Fuzzer, Many Reasoners: Adaptive Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzing with Reliability-Calibrated and Context-Gated Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.16211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural-symbolic AI (NSAI) combines learned perception with programs, constraints, and compositional reasoning, but remains difficult to test because small semantics-preserving changes can alter grounded symbols and trigger discontinuous reasoning failures. Existing neural fuzzers mainly rely on neural coverage or representation-space feedback and do not provide a common testing interface for heterogeneous NSAI systems. We introduce NSAI-Fuzz, a unified semantics-aware fuzzing framework that separates task-specific valid mutation from architecture-neutral guided search and represents each candidate using five availability-aware, rank-normalized risk signals: boundary pressure, grounding uncertainty, representation drift, constraint violation, and archive novelty. translated_title: 一个模糊测试器，多个推理器：基于可靠性校准与上下文门控引导的自适应神经符号模糊测试
translated_abstract: 神经符号人工智能（NSAI）将学习到的感知与程序、约束和组合推理相结合，但这类系统仍然难以测试，因为微小的语义保持变化可能会改变接地符号并引发不连续的推理失败。现有的神经模糊测试器主要依赖神经覆盖率或表示空间反馈，并未为异构的NSAI系统提供统一的测试接口。我们提出了NSAI-Fuzz，一个统一的语义感知模糊测试框架，它将任务特定的有效变异与架构无关的引导搜索相分离，并使用五个可用性感知、秩归一化的风险信号来表示每个候选输入：边界压力、接地不确定性、表示漂移、约束违反和档案新颖性。我们进一步提出了可靠性校准加权（RCW），它从校准后的可靠性中学习数据集-模型层面的信号分配权重，以及上下文信号门控（CSG）……
tldr: 提出统一的语义感知模糊测试框架NSAI-Fuzz，通过五种风险信号、可靠性校准加权（RCW）和上下文信号门控（CSG）实现对异构神经符号AI系统的自适应、架构无关测试引导。
en_tdlr: NSAI-Fuzz is a unified semantics-aware fuzzing framework for heterogeneous neuro-symbolic AI systems that adapts its guidance using five availability-aware risk signals combined with Reliability-Calibrated Weighting (RCW) and Contextual Signal Gating (CSG).
